name.zh: 条形磁铁 A · 北极

summary.en: Marks a pole of the bar magnet.
summary.zh: 标出条形磁铁的一个磁极。

detail.en:
This half belongs to a complete steel bar magnet, 100 × 20 × 10 mm. Its strongest pull is near its end. Pole colours identify the ends; they do not cause magnetism. Cutting a magnet makes smaller magnets with both poles. [S3].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
这一半属于完整的钢制条形磁铁，尺寸为 100 × 20 × 10 mm。靠近端部的吸力最强。两色只是极的标记，不是磁性的原因。切开后每段仍有两极。 [S3]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

name.zh: 条形磁铁 A · 南极

summary.en: Marks a pole of the bar magnet.
summary.zh: 标出条形磁铁的一个磁极。

detail.en:
This half belongs to a complete steel bar magnet, 100 × 20 × 10 mm. Its strongest pull is near its end. Pole colours identify the ends; they do not cause magnetism. Cutting a magnet makes smaller magnets with both poles. [S3].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
这一半属于完整的钢制条形磁铁，尺寸为 100 × 20 × 10 mm。靠近端部的吸力最强。两色只是极的标记，不是磁性的原因。切开后每段仍有两极。 [S3]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Pushes or pulls the other magnet.
summary.zh: 对另一根磁铁施加推力或拉力。

detail.en:
Two coloured halves form a second 100 mm bar. The guide changes the face-to-face gap from 6 to 3 to 1.5 cm. The two-pole model gives rounded pulls 12, 41 and 100 percent; reversing a magnet reverses the force sign. These are relative SIM results. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
两块异色半条拼成另一根 100 mm 磁铁。导轨让端面间隙从 6 变为 3、再变为 1.5 cm。两极模型的相对拉力取整为 12、41、100%；调头后力的正负号反转。这些是 SIM 相对值。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Brings both poles to the open tips.
summary.zh: 把两极带到开口的两端。

detail.en:
The U shape brings both poles close together. Clips cling near the tips. The two tips remain unlike poles; the bend does not remove either pole. [S3].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
U 形把两极带到相近的两端，回形针吸在极尖附近。两极仍是一北一南，弯曲不会消除任何一极。 [S3]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Pushes or pulls the other ring.
summary.zh: 推开或吸住另一只环形磁铁。

detail.en:
The rings have poles on their flat faces. Like faces push apart, lifting the upper ring. The wooden post prevents it slipping sideways. Turning a ring over makes unlike faces meet and the rings join. [S3].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
两只环形磁铁的极在平面上。同极相对时互相排斥，托住上环；木柱限制侧滑。翻过来使异极相对，两环就吸在一起。 [S3]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Pushes or pulls the other ring.
summary.zh: 推开或吸住另一只环形磁铁。

detail.en:
The rings have poles on their flat faces. Like faces push apart, lifting the upper ring. The wooden post prevents it slipping sideways. Turning a ring over makes unlike faces meet and the rings join. [S3].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
两只环形磁铁的极在平面上。同极相对时互相排斥，托住上环；木柱限制侧滑。翻过来使异极相对，两环就吸在一起。 [S3]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Guides the floating ring sideways.
summary.zh: 限制悬浮环形磁铁的侧向移动。

detail.en:
A non-magnetic wooden guide keeps the rings aligned. The ring is supported vertically by repulsion, not by a hidden shelf. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
非磁性的木柱让两环对齐。上环在竖直方向由斥力托住，没有隐藏的托架。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Protects the freely turning needle.
summary.zh: 保护能自由转动的磁针。

detail.en:
A shallow brass case surrounds the dial and needle without fixing the needle direction. Nearby bar magnets can turn the needle away from north. [S5].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
浅黄铜壳围住刻度盘与磁针，但不固定磁针的方向。附近的磁铁能让磁针偏离北方。 [S5]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Gives a fixed reference for direction.
summary.zh: 提供固定的方向参照。

detail.en:
There are 32 ticks and four longer marks in this design. The long rear mark indicates model north, toward negative Z. The dial is a reference, not a source of magnetic pull. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
本设计有 32 条刻度，其中 4 条较长。后方长刻度表示模型的北，即 Z 轴负方向。刻度盘只是方向参照，不产生磁力。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Turns as a small magnet on a pivot.
summary.zh: 绕支点转动的小磁铁。

detail.en:
A two-colour magnet balances on a low-friction pivot. Its north-seeking half turns along the local direction of magnetic action. The simulation damps the swing; the chosen period and damping describe the display, not every real compass. [S5].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
两色的小磁铁支在低摩擦支点上，指北的一半随周围磁作用的方向转动。模拟让摆动逐渐减弱；选定周期与阻尼是画面参数，不代表所有真实指南针。 [S5]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Covers the needle without touching it.
summary.zh: 罩住磁针而不碰到它。

detail.en:
A low transparent cover protects the pivot from fingers. X-ray makes only this cover and the refrigerator door transparent. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
透明低罩防止手指碰到支点。透视时只有玻璃罩和冰箱门段变透明。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Lets the bar magnet turn freely.
summary.zh: 让条形磁铁能自由转动。

detail.en:
The stand carries a thin thread and paper stirrup. Away from nearby magnets a freely suspended bar comes to rest pointing north and south. In the model the north end points toward negative Z. [S2].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
支架托住细线和纸托。远离其他磁铁时，自由悬挂的条形磁铁静止后指南北。模型里的北极转向 Z 轴负方向。 [S2]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Keeps the test objects together.
summary.zh: 把待测物品放在一起。

detail.en:
The shallow tray supports comparisons using the same magnet. All objects have separate selectable labels. The steel can is the eighth comparison object from the spec. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
浅盘便于使用同一根磁铁比较物品。每件测试物都可单独点选。钢罐作为规格中的第 8 件比较物保留。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Shows iron being attracted.
summary.zh: 显示铁会被磁铁吸引。

detail.en:
This selected nail is iron, a magnetic material. Being attracted does not prove the nail is already a permanent magnet. A magnet can pull an unmagnetised iron object. [S2].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
这根选定的钉子是铁，属于磁性材料。被吸住不能证明它原先就是永久磁铁；磁铁也能吸未磁化的铁物体。 [S2]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Shows steel being attracted.
summary.zh: 显示钢会被磁铁吸引。

detail.en:
The steel wire is bent into a clip. A shiny coating does not make it non-magnetic. These test clips stay the same size when comparing how many a magnet holds. [S2].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
钢丝弯成回形针。表面亮亮的镀层不会让内部的钢变成非磁性材料。比较吸住多少只时，要保持回形针的大小相同。 [S2]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Shows a steel container being attracted.
summary.zh: 显示钢制容器会被吸引。

detail.en:
This miniature steel container contrasts with the aluminium tab. Its dimensions are selected for the teaching tray and do not represent a standard food-can capacity. [S2].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
这只微型钢罐与铝拉环作比较。尺寸为教学盘选取，不代表标准罐头容量。 [S2]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Stays still beside the magnet.
summary.zh: 放在磁铁旁边仍不被吸起。

detail.en:
The tab is made from aluminium, a metal that is not attracted in this classroom test. Its thin loop provides a useful contrast with the iron nail and steel clips [S3].

Use the same magnet and approach each object in the same way [S1].
detail.zh:
拉环由铝制成。铝是金属，但在这项课堂测试中不被吸引，和铁钉、钢回形针形成对照 [S3]。

比较时使用同一根磁铁，以相同方式靠近各件物品 [S1]。

summary.en: Shows that copper is not attracted.
summary.zh: 显示铜不被磁铁吸引。

detail.en:
A plain solid-copper disc represents a coin-shaped test piece. It has no monetary marking and is not a copper-plated steel coin. Copper is not attracted in this classroom test [S3].

A real coin can contain several materials, so test it rather than judge by its surface colour [S1].
detail.zh:
素面实心铜片作为硬币形状的测试件，没有币值，也不是镀铜钢币。铜在这项课堂测试中不被吸引 [S3]。

真实硬币可能含有不同材料，不能仅凭表面颜色判断，应实际测试 [S1]。

summary.en: Shows a selected steel with little response.
summary.zh: 显示一种几乎不响应的特殊钢。

detail.en:
This selected spoon is austenitic stainless steel, which is almost unresponsive to a classroom magnet. Other stainless steels can be attracted; working and bending can also alter the response. Test the actual object rather than infer from its shine. [S9].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
这把选定的勺子是奥氏体不锈钢，课堂磁铁几乎吸不动。其他种类的不锈钢可能被吸引，加工弯折也可能改变响应。应实际测试，不能仅凭亮光判断。 [S9]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Stays on the tray during the test.
summary.zh: 测试时仍留在盘里。

detail.en:
Wood is a non-magnetic material in this test. The wooden support does not stop a nearby magnet pulling a steel object through it; separation still matters. [S2].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
木头在本测试中是非磁性材料。木支撑不会完全阻止磁铁隔着它吸钢件，但间隔距离仍会影响吸力。 [S2]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Shows a non-magnetic measuring tool.
summary.zh: 提供非磁性的测量工具。

detail.en:
The small plastic ruler stays on the tray when the magnet approaches. Its raised marks help compare distances [S1].

Plastic is a non-magnetic material in this classroom test [S2].
detail.zh:
磁铁靠近时，塑料小尺仍留在盘里。凸起刻度方便比较距离 [S1]。

塑料在这项课堂测试中是非磁性材料 [S2]。

summary.en: Adds a non-magnetic gap.
summary.zh: 增加非磁性的间隔。

detail.en:
Each design card is 2 mm thick. In this simulation 0–6 cards hold 10, 5, 3, 2, 1, 1 and 0 clips. These are illustrative counts, not a measured law for all magnets. The stack is elevated to give the hanging chain clearance above the bench. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
每张设计卡片厚 2 mm。本模拟隔 0–6 张卡片可吸住 10、5、3、2、1、1、0 只回形针。数字只是示意，不是所有磁铁的实测定律。卡片架升高以免下方回形针串穿过桌面。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Compares pull by the number held.
summary.zh: 用吸住的只数比较吸力。

detail.en:
Identical steel clips form a hanging chain. Change only the number of cards and observe how many clips remain held [S1].

These counts are illustrative. A real comparison must also keep clip size and the magnet unchanged [S2].
detail.zh:
相同的钢回形针组成悬挂链串。只改变卡片张数，观察还有多少只回形针被吸住 [S1]。

数量是教学示意值，实际比较也要保持回形针大小和磁铁不变 [S2]。

summary.en: Becomes a magnet after repeated strokes.
summary.zh: 反复同向摩擦后成为磁铁。

detail.en:
Stroke the steel needle with one pole in one direction, lift the magnet clear and return. In this model 0, 10, 20 and 30 strokes hold 0, 2, 4 and 6 clips [S1].

Real results depend on the needle and magnet. The direction of repeated strokes matters; there is no universal fixed stroke count [S19].
detail.zh:
用同一磁极沿同一方向摩擦钢针，抬起磁铁再回到起点。本模型摩擦 0、10、20、30 次，依次可吸 0、2、4、6 只回形针 [S1]。

真实结果取决于钢针与磁铁。反复摩擦的方向有影响，没有通用的固定次数 [S19]。

summary.en: Shows how many clips the stroked needle holds.
summary.zh: 显示摩擦后的钢针吸住的回形针只数。

detail.en: In this model 0, 10, 20 and 30 same-direction strokes let the steel needle hold 0, 2, 4 and 6 identical clips. These are illustrative SIM counts [S1].
detail.zh: 在这个模型里，同向摩擦 0、10、20、30 次后，钢针依次吸住 0、2、4、6 只相同的回形针。这些只数是 SIM 教学示意值 [S1]。

summary.en: Becomes magnetic when the coil carries current.
summary.zh: 线圈通电时变成磁铁。

detail.en:
A steel nail forms the core of this electrical-method demonstration. Steel can retain magnetism after current stops, unlike a soft-iron core which retains very little. The SIM keeps one clip after switch-off; it is not a universal residual count. [S4].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
钢钉是本次电流法演示的芯。钢在断电后能留磁，软铁芯则几乎不留。本模拟断电后留下 1 只回形针，不代表所有钢钉都有同样的剩磁。 [S4]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Makes the nail magnetic using current.
summary.zh: 用电流使钉子磁化。

detail.en:
Thirty turns of insulated copper wire surround the core. The insulation keeps neighbouring turns from touching electrically. The number of turns is fixed; only cell count and the switch vary in this topic. [S4].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
钢芯外绕 30 圈绝缘铜线。绝缘层防止相邻线圈直接导通。本主题固定圈数，只改变电池节数和开关。 [S4]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Supplies current for the coil.
summary.zh: 给线圈提供电流。

detail.en:
The repeated AA-sized cells are 14.5 mm in diameter and about 50.5 mm long in this design. With the switch on, one cell holds 3 clips and two hold 6 in this illustrative model. Use dry cells for the demonstration. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
本设计的 AA 大小电池直径 14.5 mm、长约 50.5 mm。开关接通时，本示意模型用 1 节吸 3 只、2 节吸 6 只回形针。演示只用干电池。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Closes or opens the coil circuit.
summary.zh: 闭合或断开线圈电路。

detail.en:
The slider is drawn above the contacts so it can visibly move between open and closed. Only the moving switch is a part; the support and contacts are attached to the lead assembly. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
拨钮画在触点上方，能明显显示接通与断开。这个零件只含运动的拨钮，底座和触点归入导线组件。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Completes the path through the coil.
summary.zh: 连接穿过线圈的完整电路。

detail.en:
Copper conducts inside an insulating cover. The battery tray and switch base remain visible when the moving slider changes position. The display current follows the positive-to-negative convention. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
绝缘外皮包着导电铜芯。拨钮移动时，电池托盘与开关底座仍留在原处。粒子按从正到负的约定方向表示电流。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Shows how many clips the core holds.
summary.zh: 显示钢芯吸住的回形针只数。

detail.en:
Six equal steel clips form a small pickup cluster below the nail tip. The simulation shows 3 per cell while powered and 1 after switch-off. The count is illustrative and does not pause when particle motion is stopped. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
6 只相同的钢回形针在钉尖下组成一小簇。本模拟通电时每节电池吸 3 只，断电后留 1 只。只数是示意值，暂停粒子运动不会改变物理结果。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Carries the magnetic door seal.
summary.zh: 装着带磁条的门封。

detail.en:
This is a cropped door section, not a complete refrigerator. The steel front accepts the flexible fridge magnet. A named cut exposes the seal structure; the drawing does not specify a manufactured gasket profile. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
这是一段截取的门，不是完整冰箱。钢制门面可吸住柔性冰箱贴。命名剖面露出门封内部，不代表某个厂家的胶条截面。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Pulls the seal against the steel body.
summary.zh: 把门封吸向钢制箱体。

detail.en:
A flexible magnetic strip lies inside the rubber gasket. Magnetic attraction holds the seal against the cabinet edge. The open section and enlarged hollow are teaching geometry, not a patented product reproduction. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
柔性磁条藏在橡胶门封内，磁力让门封贴住箱体边缘。开口截面和放大的空腔用于教学，不复制具体专利产品。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Holds a note against a steel door.
summary.zh: 把便条固定在钢制门面上。

detail.en:
The thin flexible backing is magnetic. A plain face avoids brand marks. The selected copper disc and aluminium tab do not become magnetic just because they look metallic. [S1].

Dimensions and placement are a teaching design, not a product specification [S1].
detail.zh:
薄薄的柔性背层有磁性，素面不带品牌。铜片和铝拉环不会因为有金属光泽就成为磁性材料。 [S1]。

尺寸和摆放由本教学设计选取，不代表具体产品规格 [S1]。

summary.en: Holds a steel plate; compares other uses.
summary.zh: 吸住钢片，并与其他用途比较。

detail.en:
A magnet between steel pole plates attracts the keeper on a cabinet door [S20]. The nearby miniature train and crane compare other magnetic uses.

The train display shows support with a guide; it is a teaching model, not a scale vehicle. The crane holds steel with a round lifting magnet. Attraction-type trains and switchable lifting magnets work in different arrangements [S21, S4].
detail.zh:
门扣里的磁铁夹在钢极板之间，吸住柜门的钢吸片 [S20]。旁边的列车和起重机小模型用来比较其他用途。

列车模型表示磁力支撑与导轨约束，不是等比例车辆；吊车用圆形起重磁铁吸住钢件。吸引式列车与可开关起重磁铁的结构安排不同 [S21, S4]。

summary.en: Shows the pattern around the magnets.
summary.zh: 显示磁铁周围的作用图样。

detail.en:
Iron filings on the paper line up in a pattern, crowding near the poles. The neighbouring line card is another way to show the direction around the magnet [S5].

These patterns are calculated representations. The drawn curves are not material flowing out of a magnet. Paper sizes and particle sizes are selected for the teaching display [S1].
detail.zh:
纸上的铁屑排成图样，在磁极附近较密。旁边的曲线卡用另一种方式显示磁铁周围的作用方向 [S5]。

图样是计算得到的表示法，画出的曲线不是磁铁流出的物质。纸张与颗粒的大小按教学展示选取 [S1]。
